 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The 1-background rectangle is the picture. Three isolated marks outside it
    # specify which way its L-shaped corner markers should face.
    ones = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in ones), max(r for r, c in ones)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in ones), max(c for r, c in ones)
    panel = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    outside = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row)
               if v not in (0, 1) and not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1)]
    # Locate the right-angle corner and the two directions of its arms.
    if len(outside) >= 3:
        p = [(r, c, v) for r, c, v in outside]
        corner = None
        for i, (r, c, v) in enumerate(p):
            others = [x for j, x in enumerate(p) if j != i]
            if any(x[0] == r for x in others) and any(x[1] == c for x in others):
                corner = (r, c, v)
                break
        if corner:
            r, c, _ = corner
            horizontal = next((x for x in p if x[0] == r and x[1] != c), None)
            vertical = next((x for x in p if x[1] == c and x[0] != r), None)
            hd = 'left' if horizontal and horizontal[1] < c else 'right'
            vd = 'up' if vertical and vertical[0] < r else 'down'
            if (hd, vd) == ('left', 'down'):
                # Anti-diagonal reflection.
                return [list(row) for row in zip(*panel[::-1])][::-1]
            if (hd, vd) == ('right', 'down'):
                # Main-diagonal reflection.
                return [list(col) for col in zip(*panel)]
            if (hd, vd) == ('left', 'up'):
                # Vertical reflection.
                return panel[::-1]
            if (hd, vd) == ('right', 'up'):
                return [row[::-1] for row in panel]
    return panel
"
}
